# docker_compose_config (Data Source)

Renders a compose project the way `docker compose config` does, without the CLI and without contacting the daemon. The project is parsed, interpolated (only with `env` and `env_file`), merged and validated by compose-go; `compose_yaml` is the canonical YAML, `project` the same model as a structured object, and `content_sha256` detects change.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_compose_config" "shop" {
  name              = "shop"
  project_directory = path.module
  env               = { WEB_TAG = "1.27-alpine" }
  content           = <<-EOT
    services:
      web:
        image: nginx:$${WEB_TAG}
  EOT
}

# The canonical YAML `docker compose config` would print, and one field of it.
output "compose_yaml" {
  value     = data.docker_compose_config.shop.compose_yaml
  sensitive = true
}

output "web_image" {
  value = data.docker_compose_config.shop.project.services["web"].image
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `content` (String) Compose YAML as a string. Exactly one of `content` and `files` must be set.
- `env` (Map of String, Sensitive) Variables for `${VAR}` interpolation. The provider's own environment is never read; values here override `env_file`.
- `env_file` (List of String) Dotenv files read for interpolation variables (CLI `--env-file`), later files winning.
- `files` (List of String) Compose file paths, merged in order like repeated `docker compose -f`.
- `name` (String) The compose project name (compose-spec top-level `name`, CLI `--project-name`). Defaults to the file's top-level `name`, then to the project directory's name.
- `profiles` (List of String) Profiles to enable (CLI `--profile`).
- `project_directory` (String) The project directory relative paths resolve against (CLI `--project-directory`). Defaults to the first file's directory, or the Terraform working directory for `content`.

### Read-Only

- `compose_go_version` (String) compose-go version that loads, interpolates, merges and validates the project (v2.16.2, from go.mod).
- `compose_spec_version` (String) Pinned compose-spec commit the structured fields follow (main @ 3a4a699...).
- `compose_yaml` (String, Sensitive) Normalized compose config as `docker compose config` prints it: interpolated, include/extends resolved, merged, profiles applied.
- `content_sha256` (String) Hex SHA-256 of `compose_yaml`.
- `image_refs` (Map of String) Map of service name to the image it runs after interpolation (`image`, or `<project>-<service>` for a build-only service).
- `project` (Attributes) The whole normalized project (same shape as `project` on docker_compose). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--project))
- `service_names` (List of String) The enabled services of the project, sorted.
